objectKey.description: claim check: an object-store key under the owner's prefix u/<owner_id>/ (never bytes)

seq.description: per-job sequence over every evt.run.* message of one run (= envelope job_id), starting at 1; the projector dedupes on (job_id, seq)

attempt.description: the run's attempt: 1, or 2 after the dispatcher lost the lease of attempt 1 and queued the run again (a run command is delivered once)

hostName.description: a GPU host's name: lower-case letters and digits (one NATS subject token)

envName.description: a runner env on a host (mlx, torch, fake)

nodeId.description: a node's id inside one workflow graph

nodeKind.description: a node schema's kind: a core node (prompt, output) or <family>/<node> (echo/echo)

portRef.description: <node id>.<output name> of another node in the same graph

paramValue.description: a param value: int, float, bool, string, text, enum or seed (see registry.schema.json paramSchema); null only for a seed (random)

params.description: param name → value; a param left out takes its node schema's default

in.description: input port name → the output it is wired to

graph.description: a workflow's node graph: node id → node

seed.description: a seed the runner actually used (exact in a JS number)

inputs.description: <node id>.<param name> → value (RunRequest.inputs); only the params to change

workflowSnapshot.description: a registry workflow as it was when the batch was submitted; the batch runs this graph, never the live one

batchRow.description: a batch row number, from 1 (after seed repetition)

rowAttempt.description: a batch row's attempt: 1, +1 on every Retry of the row

idempotencyKey.description: <batch_id>:<row>:<row attempt>:<graph node>:<loop count>:<branch>, e.g. …:3:1:step:0:0. A batch of one workflow uses node `step`, loop 0, branch `0`. studio.runs.create returns the same run for the same key

rowStatus.description: pipelines' view of a row: queued = not started; running = its run was requested and has not finished

batchStatus.description: set by pipelines_service (queued exists only in studio's record, before the first event)
